before.styles: Instrumental post-hardcore rock, fixed 175 BPM in E Minor, straight 4/4 from the first bar through the final hit. Strong punchy kick and cracking snare carry an unmistakable full-speed running step throughout. A high single-note guitar theme cuts across low chord guitars on Em -> Am -> C -> B. Tom rolls feed each transition without silencing the kick or snare. A syncopated bass answer climbs toward B; the instrumental hook expands the upper melody into two guitars and drives immediately back to Em. Aim for about 3:28.
before.exclude: vocals, spoken word, jazz, drill, half-time drums, tempo changes, beatless breakdown, ambient intro
